title: Reverse implication for pointwise basic-open detection
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], L an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module], S its graded section ring [def-sc-invertible-section-ring], and f:X -> Proj(S) [def-pc-proj]. Assume for every homogeneous u of positive degree r, every n >= 0, and every homogeneous xi of degree nr, that on f^{-1}(D_+(u)) the restricted tensor-power sections satisfy f^sharp(xi/u^n) u^n = xi. Let x admit a homogeneous section t of some degree e > 0 nonvanishing at x [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Let s be homogeneous of degree d > 0. If s is nonvanishing at x, then f(x) belongs to D_+(s).

proof.text: For a homogeneous component, choose its DirectSum.of preimage. DirectSum.of_mul_of and DirectSum.of_eq_same identify the component of a product with tmulSection followed by tensorPowAddIso.inv. If both component sections generate at x, intersect their generator neighbourhoods; restriction preserves free generators, IsFreeGenerator.tmulSection gives a generator of the tensor product, and IsFreeGenerator.app_hom transports it along tensorPowAddIso.symm. Induction using pow_succ and succ_nsmul proves that every positive power of a nonvanishing homogeneous section is nonvanishing in its corresponding tensor degree. Convert nonvanishing to GeneratesAt and back with mem_nonvanishingLocus_iff_generatesAt. These are the three proved private helpers sectionRing_component_mul, sectionRing_generatesAt_mul, and sectionRing_power_nonvanishing.

proof.text: Put y=f(x). The point y does not contain the irrelevant ideal. HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le implies that there are e>0 and t in degree e with y in D_+(t); this is the proved private helper exists_sectionRing_chart. Set xi=s^e in degree d*e, using e*d=d*e. The preceding induction proves that xi is nonvanishing at x. Specialize hformula to this t, exponent d, and numerator xi.

proof.text: In the stalk of X at x, the fraction formula reads alpha times the germ of t^d equals the germ of xi. If alpha belonged to the maximal ideal, Submodule.smul_mem_smul would put the latter germ in the maximal ideal times the module, contradicting nonvanishing. PresheafOfModules.germ_smul and TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply identify these germs. Thus alpha is a unit; this is scalar_isUnit_of_nonvanishing, which works for every module without requiring invertibility. Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply and isUnit_map_iff for the local stalk homomorphism reflect this unit back to the Proj stalk.

proof.text: ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.awayToSection_germ identifies the fraction germ with the image of xi/t^d in homogeneous localization. Transport the unit along Proj.stalkIso', apply HomogeneousLocalization.isUnit_iff_isUnit_val, then Localization.mk_eq_mk' and IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_mk'_iff. This proves that xi=s^e is outside the homogeneous prime y (private helper chart_fraction_numerator_notMem). Proj.basicOpen_pow for e>0 identifies D_+(s^e) with D_+(s), giving the desired preimage membership. The hypotheses hx and hd are not needed for this direction, and remain unchanged in the signature.

theorem sectionRing_proj_mem_basicOpen_reverse (X : Scheme.{v}) (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (f : X ⟶ Proj (sectionRingGrade L))
    (hformula : ∀ (d : ℕ) (_hd : 0 < d) (s : sectionRingGrade L d),
        ∀ (n : ℕ) (ξ : sectionRingGrade L (n • d)),
          (f.app (Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) s.val)
            (Proj.awayToSection (sectionRingGrade L) s.val
              (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (sectionRingGrade L) s.property n
                ξ.val ξ.property))) •
            (L.tensorPow (n • d)).presheaf.map (homOfLE
              (le_top : f ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) s.val ≤ ⊤)).op
              ((s.val ^ n) (n • d)) =
          (L.tensorPow (n • d)).presheaf.map (homOfLE
              (le_top : f ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) s.val ≤ ⊤)).op
            (ξ.val (n • d)))
    (x : X)
    (hx : ∃ (e : ℕ) (t : sectionRingGrade L e),
      0 < e ∧ x ∈ nonvanishingLocus (L.tensorPow e) (t.val e))
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (s : sectionRingGrade L d) :
    x ∈ nonvanishingLocus (L.tensorPow d) (s.val d) →
      x ∈ f ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) s.val
